title.zh-TW: 全螢幕輸入框支援滑鼠點選與反白
title.en: Mouse Cursor Placement and Selection in Full-Screen Input

body.zh-TW:
寫了一長串提問想改中間幾個字，不用再按著方向鍵慢慢挪動游標。在 `full screen (altscreen)` 顯示模式的輸入框裡，點一下就能把游標移到指定位置。你也能拖曳、連點兩下，或連點兩下再拖曳來按單字反白文字，放開滑鼠時不會蓋掉原本的剪貼簿內容。選好文字後可直接打字或貼上取代，也支援 `Backspace`、`Delete`、`Ctrl+C` 複製與 `Ctrl+X` 剪下。

如果開啟了 Vim 模式，在 Insert 模式以外用滑鼠選取文字，會進入逐字元選取的 Visual 模式，讓 Vim 的操作與移動指令直接作用在選取範圍上。而在 Normal 模式下點到行尾之後的位置時，游標會落在該行最後一個字元。⟦過去改這幾行字得像用老式打字機一樣一格格挪，現在則能直接拿滑鼠在畫面上點選、拉出反白，整段搬動或替換都不卡手。⟧
body.en:
When you have typed a long prompt and want to change a few words in the middle, you no longer have to hold down arrow keys to nudge the cursor over. Inside the prompt box in `full screen (altscreen)` rendering mode, a single click moves the cursor right where you want it. You can also drag, double-click, or double-click and drag by word to highlight text without overwriting your clipboard on release. Once selected, you can type or paste to replace it, or use `Backspace`, `Delete`, `Ctrl+C` to copy, and `Ctrl+X` to cut.

When Vim mode is on, selecting text with the mouse outside Insert mode enters characterwise Visual mode so Vim operators and motions act directly on the selection. Clicking past the end of a line in Normal mode places the cursor on the last character of that line. ⟦Editing those few lines used to feel like nudging an old typewriter carriage one space at a time, whereas now you can click and drag right on the screen to highlight and move or swap whole chunks effortlessly.⟧

items.original: Added mouse cursor placement and text selection inside the prompt box in the `full screen (altscreen)` rendering mode: click to move the cursor, or drag and double-click (and double-click-drag by word) to highlight text for typing or paste replacement, `Backspace`/`Delete`, `Ctrl+C` copy, and `Ctrl+X` cut without overwriting your clipboard on release. When Vim mode is on, mouse selections outside Insert mode enter characterwise Visual mode so Vim operators and motions act on the selection, and Normal-mode clicks past the end of a line land on the last character.

title.zh-TW: 背景指令改為主動回報免重複輪詢
title.en: Active Wakeups Replace Polling for Background Commands

body.zh-TW: 交辦長時間執行的背景終端機指令後，過去代理程式得另外開輪詢計時器來回檢查進度。現在追蹤背景指令時能直接排定喚醒通知，指令還在跑的話，CLI 就會自動通知代理程式，省下額外的查詢輪次。⟦不再像等快遞時一直開門探頭，快遞員會在還在路上時主動傳訊息通知，省下一次次白跑。⟧
body.en: After handing off a long-running background shell command, the agent used to spin up separate polling timers to check on progress back and forth. Now, tracking a background command can schedule a wakeup notification directly, so the CLI automatically notifies the agent if the command is still running and saves extra check-in turns. ⟦Instead of opening the door every few minutes to check for a delivery, the courier texts you while still on the way, saving you all those wasted trips.⟧

items.original: Improved background shell command tracking by letting `run_command` set a `NotificationTimeoutSeconds` wakeup, so the CLI automatically notifies the agent when a long-running command is still running instead of spending extra turns on separate polling timers.

title.zh-TW: Orchestrator 支援同設定直跑與新標示
title.en: Direct Single-Agent Runs and New Labels in Orchestrator

body.zh-TW:
在 `/model` 的 `Orchestrator` 這一列挑模型，現在操作更清楚，也不用多繞一圈。目前選中的思考強度 `Effort` 選項會加上方括號，例如 `[high]`，`Tab` 鍵提示也從 `tab Effort` 改成 `tab Next Field`。

只要 `Planner` 和 `Executor` 選用相同模型與 `Effort`，就會直接以單一代理程式在該模型執行。這時終端機底部的狀態列會顯示該模型，`/btw` 會沿用它，`/context` 也會改用它的 context window（模型單次能處理的內容容量上限）。若是同模型家族但選了不同的 `Effort`，則繼續跑先規劃再執行的兩階段模式。⟦跟寫作時一樣，若構思大綱和潤稿都用同一套標準，不如直接一氣呵成；只有兩階段想用不同力道時，才值得分兩輪處理。⟧
body.en:
Picking a model on the `Orchestrator` row in `/model` is now clearer and avoids unnecessary detours. The currently selected thinking `Effort` option is wrapped in brackets, such as `[high]`, and the `Tab` hint changes from `tab Effort` to `tab Next Field`.

Whenever `Planner` and `Executor` use the same model and `Effort`, it runs directly as a single agent on that model. At that point, the status line at the bottom of the terminal shows that model, `/btw` inherits it, and `/context` switches to its context window (the maximum amount of content a model can process at once). If you choose different `Effort` levels within the same model family, it continues running the two-phase plan-and-execute mode. ⟦Think of writing a piece: if you apply the same standard to both outlining and polishing, it makes more sense to write it straight through, and only split into two passes when each stage calls for a different level of effort.⟧

items.original:
Improved the `Orchestrator` row in `/model` so that picking the same model and thinking `Effort` for both `Planner` and `Executor` runs single-agent directly on that model — showing it in the status line, inheriting it in `/btw`, and using its context window in `/context` — while distinct `Effort` levels of the same model family continue to run two-phase plan-and-execute.
Improved the `Orchestrator` row in `/model` by bracketing the focused thinking `Effort` choice (such as `[high]`) and labeling `Tab` as `tab Next Field` instead of `tab Effort`.

title.zh-TW: /usage 滿一天改用天數顯示額度倒數
title.en: /usage Shows Quota Countdowns in Days Over 24 Hours

body.zh-TW: 想確認還要等多久才會重算額度，過去遇到大於一整天的數字，得自己把小時換算成天數。現在輸入 `/usage` 查看，只要額度更新倒數滿 24 小時以上，就會改用天、小時與分鐘顯示。舉例來說，畫面上會寫成 `in 3d 3h 59m`，不再是原本的 `in 75h 59m`。
body.en: When checking how long until your quota resets, any number over a full day used to require converting hours into days in your head. Now, running `/usage` displays quota refresh countdowns of 24 hours or longer in days, hours, and minutes. For example, the screen shows `in 3d 3h 59m` instead of `in 75h 59m`.

items.original: Improved `/usage` to format quota refresh countdowns of 24 hours or longer in days, hours, and minutes (such as `in 3d 3h 59m` instead of `in 75h 59m`).

title.zh-TW: /mcp 與 /plugin 的遠端登入不再過期斷線
title.en: Remote Logins in /mcp and /plugin No Longer Expire Mid-Session

body.zh-TW:
連上遠端工具卻用一陣子就突然斷線，往往是初次登入的憑證過期了。現在透過 `/mcp` 與 `/plugin` 替 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器做 OAuth 登入，會多做一層確認。

只要伺服器有指定權限範圍 `scopes`，且驗證伺服器宣告支援 `offline_access`，CLI 就會一併請求 `offline_access`。這樣像 Vercel 這類遠端伺服器就會核發更新用的 token（驗證用的授權令牌），不至於在原本的存取憑證過期後直接斷線。⟦就像拿著只管一陣子的訪客證進門，時間一到就得重新核對證件；預先申請可換發的憑證後，快過期就能自動換新證，不必中途被請出場。⟧
body.en:
Connecting to a remote tool only to get disconnected after a while often happens because the initial login credential expires. Now, signing in with OAuth for an MCP (Model Context Protocol, a standard for connecting AI to external tools) server via `/mcp` and `/plugin` adds an extra check.

Whenever the server specifies `scopes` and its authorization server advertises `offline_access`, the CLI requests `offline_access` as well. That way, remote servers like Vercel issue refresh tokens (credentials used for authentication) so you do not get disconnected as soon as the initial access credential expires. ⟦Picture entering a building with a temporary visitor pass that forces another ID check once it expires; requesting a renewable pass upfront lets it swap for a fresh one before time runs out, so you are not escorted out mid-visit.⟧

items.original: Improved MCP server OAuth sign-in in `/mcp` and `/plugin` to request `offline_access` when the server specifies scopes and its authorization server advertises `offline_access`, so remote MCP servers such as Vercel's issue refresh tokens instead of disconnecting when the initial access token expires.

title.zh-TW: 修正斜線指令選單按 Tab 補全失效
title.en: Fixed Tab Completion in the Slash-Command Menu

body.zh-TW: 打 `/` 叫出指令補全選單後，過去只要多個指令開頭相同、用 `↑` 或 `↓` 切換過項目，或剛輸入 `plugin:`，按 `Tab` 都會完全沒反應。這個問題已經修好，現在只要沒有更長的共同前綴可以延伸，按 `Tab` 就會補全目前反白的指令並關閉選單。
body.en: After typing `/` to open the command completion menu, pressing `Tab` used to do nothing whenever multiple commands shared a prefix, after navigating items with `↑` or `↓`, or right after typing `plugin:`. That is fixed now: whenever no longer common prefix can be extended, pressing `Tab` completes the highlighted command and closes the menu.

items.original: Fixed pressing `Tab` in the `/` slash-command autocomplete menu doing nothing when multiple commands shared what you typed, after navigating with `↑` or `↓`, or right after a `plugin:` prefix; `Tab` now completes the highlighted command and closes the menu whenever no longer common prefix can be extended.

title.zh-TW: 修正全螢幕模式面板與選單捲動錯位
title.en: Fixed Panel and Menu Scrolling in Full-Screen Mode

body.zh-TW:
在 `full screen (altscreen)` 顯示模式下，過去想捲動開啟的面板或選單時，捲動的卻是背後的對話內容。這個問題已經修好，現在把滑鼠滾輪移到底部面板，或 `/`、`@` 與參數下拉選單上捲動，只會捲動面板本身。

在 `/help`、`/permissions`、`/skills`、`/context`、`/usage` 這類會自行分頁的面板操作時也一樣。按 `PgUp`、`PgDn`、`Shift+↑` 或 `Shift+↓`，只會切換面板頁數，不會捲到背後對話。
body.en:
In `full screen (altscreen)` rendering mode, trying to scroll an open panel or menu used to scroll the conversation behind it instead. That is fixed now: scrolling the mouse wheel over an open bottom panel or a `/`, `@`, or argument dropdown only scrolls the panel itself.

The same goes for panels that page themselves, such as `/help`, `/permissions`, `/skills`, `/context`, and `/usage`. Pressing `PgUp`, `PgDn`, `Shift+↑`, or `Shift+↓` only flips pages within the panel without scrolling the conversation behind it.

items.original: Fixed mouse-wheel scrolling over an open bottom panel or `/`, `@`, or argument dropdown — and `PgUp`, `PgDn`, `Shift+↑`, or `Shift+↓` in panels that page themselves (such as `/help`, `/permissions`, `/skills`, `/context`, and `/usage`) — scrolling the conversation behind the panel instead of the panel itself in the `full screen (altscreen)` rendering mode.

title.zh-TW: 修正 agy update 狀態訊息階梯縮排
title.en: Fixed Staircase Indentation in agy update Status Output

body.zh-TW: 在終端機開啟 raw output 模式跑更新指令，印出來的每行訊息都會一路往右偏。這個問題已經修好，現在執行 `agy update` 時，每行狀態訊息都會對齊輸出，而透過管線傳輸或導向存進檔案時，仍維持原本的純換行格式。
body.en: When running the update command in a terminal with raw output mode enabled, each printed status line used to drift further to the right. That is fixed now: running `agy update` aligns every status line cleanly, while piped or file-redirected output keeps the original newline-only format.

items.original: Fixed `agy update` printing status lines with staircase indentation when run in a terminal with raw output mode enabled, while keeping newline-only output when piped or redirected to a file.

title.zh-TW: 長對話遇憑證過期或模型滿載可續跑
title.en: Long Sessions Resume Through Token Expiry and Capacity Limits

body.zh-TW:
讓代理程式連續跑比較久的任務，最怕快完成時遇到中途連線狀況而整段白費。

當 Google OAuth 的存取 token 跨過一小時效期，過去會直接跳出 `UNAUTHENTICATED` 與 `401` 錯誤而中斷。現在 CLI 會在過期前預先更新 token，串流開始前若遇到 `401` 也會自動重試。

若是分多段串流的長篇模型回應，續傳遇到暫時性 `503` 或 `MODEL_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED` 容量不足錯誤，過去會丟失進度而重來或失敗。現在 CLI 會自動重試，直接從原本中斷的地方接續完成。
body.en:
When letting an agent run a longer task continuously, the worst feeling is hitting a mid-run connection issue right before the finish line and losing the whole stretch.

When a Google OAuth access token crosses its one-hour expiry, it used to fail right away with `UNAUTHENTICATED` and `401` errors. Now the CLI refreshes the token before it expires, and automatically retries if it hits a `401` before streaming starts.

For long, multi-part streaming model responses, hitting a temporary `503` or `MODEL_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED` capacity error during continuation used to discard progress and restart or fail. Now the CLI retries automatically and picks up right where it left off.

items.original:
Fixed long-running agent turns failing with an `UNAUTHENTICATED` (`401`) error when a Google OAuth access token crossed its one-hour expiry; the CLI now refreshes tokens ahead of expiry and retries a pre-stream `401` automatically.
Fixed long, multi-part streaming model responses discarding their progress and restarting or failing the turn when a continuation request hit a temporary model capacity (`503` / `MODEL_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED`) error; the CLI now retries and resumes from where the response left off.

title.zh-TW: 修正企業預付餘額歸零時的錯誤提示
title.en: Fixed Error Message When Enterprise Prepaid Balance Hits Zero

body.zh-TW:
Gemini Enterprise 預付錢包歸零後，過去會反覆重試並誤報額度用完的 `You have exhausted your quota on this model.`。現在 CLI 會立刻停止，改顯示下列提示：

```
Your organization's prepaid balance is insufficient. Contact your administrator to add funds.
```

遠端控制網頁上也會顯示 `Organization prepaid wallet is empty` 的提醒。
body.en:
When a Gemini Enterprise prepaid wallet hit zero, the CLI used to retry repeatedly and mistakenly report `You have exhausted your quota on this model.`. Now the CLI stops immediately and displays the following message instead:

```
Your organization's prepaid balance is insufficient. Contact your administrator to add funds.
```

The Remote Control web view also shows an `Organization prepaid wallet is empty` notice.

items.original: Fixed turns on Gemini Enterprise accounts with an empty prepaid wallet retrying repeatedly and reporting `You have exhausted your quota on this model.`; the CLI now stops right away and tells you `Your organization's prepaid balance is insufficient. Contact your administrator to add funds.` (with an `Organization prepaid wallet is empty` notice in the Remote Control browser view).

title.zh-TW: 修正企業版存取外部檔案繞過敏感檔保護
title.en: Fix sensitive file protections bypassed by enterprise external access

body.zh-TW: 你使用 Gemini Enterprise 或企業模型閘道的工作階段，且允許取用工作區以外的路徑，過去卻會直接跳過確認與封鎖關卡。受影響的敏感檔案包括 `.git`、`.env`、`config.json`、`hooks.json` 與 `mcp_config.json`。這個問題已經修好，現在內建的核准與拒絕保護機制不會再被繞過。
body.en: When you used Gemini Enterprise or enterprise model-gateway sessions with access to paths outside the workspace allowed, confirmation and block checks used to be skipped. Affected sensitive files include `.git`, `.env`, `config.json`, `hooks.json`, and `mcp_config.json`. This issue is fixed, and built-in approval and deny protections are no longer bypassed.

items.original: Fixed Gemini Enterprise and enterprise model-gateway sessions with non-workspace file access allowed bypassing built-in approval and deny protections on sensitive files such as `.git`, `.env`, `config.json`, `hooks.json`, and `mcp_config.json`.

title.zh-TW: 修正 Windows 跨磁碟執行外掛漏帶 token
title.en: Fix missing token when running plugins across Windows drives

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 上關掉終端機沙盒，又把工作區和使用者設定檔分開放在不同槽，過去啟動 CLI 工具時會少帶驗證資訊。這個問題已經修好，現在外掛工具能順利取得原本設定的驗證 token 執行。
body.en: When the terminal sandbox was off on Windows and your workspace and user profile were on different drives, launching CLI tools used to miss authentication details. This issue is fixed, so plugin tools now run with their configured authentication token.

items.original: Fixed plugin CLI tools on Windows running without their configured authentication token when the terminal sandbox is off and your workspace is on a different drive letter than your user profile.

title.zh-TW: 修正遠端控制網頁回應期間鎖定模型選單
title.en: Fix model picker locked during responses in Remote Control

body.zh-TW: 這一輪還在跑的時候，你想在瀏覽器裡先換個選項來發問，卻發現訊息框裡的切換鈕完全按不動。這個問題已經修好，現在遠端控制網頁在回應進行到一半時也能切換模型，用來處理 `/btw` 順帶提問或接在這一輪之後送出的訊息。
body.en: While a turn was still running, trying to switch options in the browser to ask a question meant the toggle in the message box would not respond at all. This issue is fixed, so the Remote Control browser view now lets you switch models mid-turn for `/btw` side questions or messages sent after the current turn.

items.original: Fixed the model picker in the message box of the Remote Control browser view being locked while a turn is running; you can now switch models mid-turn for `/btw` side questions and messages sent after the current turn.

title.zh-TW: 修正遠端控制網頁含 \label 數學式無法顯示
title.en: Fix LaTeX math with \label failing to render in Remote Control

body.zh-TW: 在瀏覽器打開 AI 算出的 LaTeX 公式，過去只要裡面帶有標籤，畫面上就會跳出 `Failed to render LaTeX` 錯誤。這個問題已經修好，現在遠端控制網頁也能正常顯示含有 `\label{...}` 標籤的數學區塊。
body.en: When opening LaTeX formulas generated by AI in the browser, any formula containing a label used to trigger a `Failed to render LaTeX` error on screen. This issue is fixed, and the Remote Control browser view now properly renders math blocks containing `\label{...}` tags.

items.original: Fixed LaTeX math blocks containing `\label{...}` failing to render with `Failed to render LaTeX` in the Remote Control browser view.
